2278.name: Mr. Smile
description: A simple mask with a smile carved into it.

2279.name: Bomb Wick
description: A wick-like ornament worn on top of the head for a dangerous look.

2280.name: Sakkat
description: A rustic hat knit from rough reeds and bamboos that shields against the rain and the glare of the sun.
Ssaurabi, the ancient Korean warrior, was known to wear one of these.

2281.name: Opera Mask
description: A mysterious mask traditionally worn by opera phantoms.

2282.name: Halo
description: A spiritual symbol that typically appears over the heads of those who are holy.
Decreases damage taken from ^777777Holy^000000 elemental attacks by 15%.

2283.name: Ear Muffs
description: Ear coverings, linked by a headband, that protect the wearer's ears from the cold.
Decreases damage taken from ^663399Curse^000000 status by 10%.

2284.name: Antlers
description: A set of deer antlers that humans, finally, can proudly wear.

2285.name: Apple of Archer
description: A headgear made in the honor of the legendary archer who shot an apple, on top of a friend's head, from a long distance.

2286.name: Elven Ears
description: A fashion accessory that gives ears that vaunted, elvish look.
For some, it is an incredible turn-on.

2287.name: Pirate Bandana
description: A bandana that is the mark of the lawless pirates of the oceans.

2288.name: Mr. Scream
description: A mask that expresses anguish and despair borne of insanity.

2289.name: Poo Poo Hat
description: A hat which looks just like fecal matter that is guaranteed to end a date on a tragic note.
Decreases damage taken from ^FF0000Demi-Human^000000 race by 10%.

2290.name: Funeral Hat
description: Traditional Korean headdress worn during funeral ceremonies by the bereaved family and close friends.

2291.name: Butterfly Mask
description: A black leather mask, shaped like butterfly wings.
Increases Physical Damage against enemies of ^FF0000Demi-Human^000000 race by 3%.

2292.name: Welding Mask
description: A durable mask made from a fat metal plate that is usually worn by welders and Blacksmiths.
Decreases damage taken from ^FF0000Fire^000000 elemental attacks by 10%.

2293.name: Pretend Murdered
description: A stage prop that creates the illusion that the wearer has a knife sticking out of his head.

2294.name: Stellar
description: A small, star shaped hairclip that makes a great present for ladies.

2295.name: Blinkers
description: A face mask that is worn by those who have trouble sleeping.

2296.name: Binoculars
description: A special optical tool that enables one to observe objects from a great distance.

2297.name: Goblin Mask
description: A mask worn by Goblins to scare and intimidate unsuspecting enemies.

2298.name: Green Feeler
description: Large insect antennae that humans can wear.

2299.name: Orc Helm
description: A hardy helmet that was crafted by the most expert of Orcish smiths.
